summary: Each integral commutes with the coordinate; sum and integral commute under absolute summability.

steps.claim: The i-th coordinate of each ∫g_j is ∫(g_j)_i (eval_integral_piLp, the g_j being integrable as their norms have finite integrals); the coordinate map commutes with the convergent sum (the sum of the norms of the integrals is finite); and ∑_j ∫(g_j)_i = ∫ ∑_j (g_j)_i (integral_tsum, the sum of the integrals of the norms being finite).
steps.lean:
i : (∑' j, ∫ x, g j x ∂μ) i = ∫ x, ∑' j, g j x i ∂μ := .trans ((funext fun j ↦
  eval_integral_piLp (.eval_piLp ⟨by fun_prop, (ENNReal.le_tsum j).trans_lt h⟩) i) ▸
  (EuclideanSpace.proj i).map_tsum (.of_enorm (ne_of_lt (by grw [enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm,
  h])))) (integral_tsum (by fun_prop) (ne_of_lt (by grw [PiLp.enorm_apply_le, h]))).symm
